title: Irish Stew with Chickpea Dumplings
description: A hearty Irish stew with chickpea dumplings, perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine chickpeas, flour, and aerated water. Mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to about 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut into small squares and set aside.
In a large Dutch oven, sauté the onion, carrot, and potato in a little bit of oil until tender.
Add the Irish stew mix and stir to combine.
Add the chickpea dumplings to the stew and cover with a lid.
Transfer the Dutch oven to the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes.
